categories.label: Charger availability mismatch
categories.description: App showed a charger/station as available but it was actually occupied, offline or out of order.

categories.label: Session fails to start
categories.description: Charging session never starts after initiating from the app (no energy delivered).

categories.label: Session stops unexpectedly
categories.description: A started charging session terminates early before target SoC/completion.

categories.label: Payment or billing failure
categories.description: Money deducted without service, wrong amount, double charge, refund pending or transaction stuck.

categories.label: Incorrect or delayed station status
categories.description: Station/charger status shown in the app is stale or wrong relative to the network log.

categories.label: App crash or technical error
categories.description: The mobile app itself crashes, freezes, or shows an unhandled technical error screen.

categories.label: Network or connectivity issue
categories.description: Connectivity loss between app and server, or charger and cloud (heartbeat lost, timeouts).

categories.label: Connector or charger hardware fault
categories.description: Physical fault in connector/gun/charger: locking failure, overheating, fault codes from hardware.

categories.label: Vehicle-charger communication issue
categories.description: Handshake/protocol negotiation between vehicle and charger fails (e.g. ISO 15118 / CAN handshake).

categories.label: Incorrect or incomplete charging history
categories.description: Past sessions missing, duplicated or with wrong values in the app's charging history view.

categories.label: Customer support issue
categories.description: Complaint about slow/unhelpful support, no response to tickets, unresolved refunds via support.

categories.label: Vehicle-specific or telematics issue
categories.description: Companion-app telemetry wrong: SoC not updating, range display wrong, vehicle offline in app, BMS errors.
